描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. this is the figure of a state official's wife holding a tray with a fish, standing on a hexagonal plinth, her body made of earthenware with pale green lead glaze. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 这是一个国家官员的妻子的形象，拿着装有鱼的托盘，站在一个六边形的基座上，她的身体是由浅绿色铅釉的陶器制成。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
